title: Animetlik
tagline: Web3 platform for manga/manhwa & fanfic creators: fair subscriptions, instant on-chain payouts.
description: Animetlik is a Web3 publishing platform for manga, manhwa, and fanfic that turns reader subscriptions into transparent, automatic on-chain revenue splits (50% author / 35% platform / 15% staking). Originally built for Monad’s high-throughput EVM, for this hackathon we added ENS integration so every creator can claim a free subdomain (their channel) to publish series and videos and share a verifiable identity. Wallet connect is seamless, receipts are public, payouts are instant, and the system scales as our catalog grows.
how_its_made: We built Animetlik as a Web3 subscription platform with on-chain revenue splits (50/35/15). Core is a Solidity **SubscriptionManager** that routes each payment and emits auditable events. The app was first integrated for **Monad** (parallel EVM, fast finality); for this hackathon we **extended the smart contract to integrate ENS** so authors can **claim a free subdomain** (e.g., *creator.animetlik.eth*) that becomes their public channel for publishing. Front end: **Next.js/React + TypeScript**, wallet connection via **Reown (ex-WalletConnect)**, on-chain I/O with **viem/ethers**, and a lightweight indexer (Node) to stream contract events to creator dashboards. Media/catalog metadata is stored on **IPFS** with content hashes referenced on-chain. Hacky bits worth noting: gas-optimized split using **minimal proxies** for creator payout vaults, ENS subdomain mint with collision checks, and a local faucet/simulator to pressure-test bursts of subscription events. Post-hackathon we’ll continue on Monad and offer ENS subdomains to all authors.
